essence: The arrangement is divided into two groups of nine within the brahma portion.
Letter arrangement is presented as an eternal form in the meter portion.
The subtle elements and following items are placed in the middle with eight in number.
The sequence runs from śakti to puruṣa and includes heart and following armors.
World lords, gaṇeśas, and vidyeśvaras are assigned in the brahma portion to Hari.
